[Claim 1] A travel control apparatus to be mounted on a vehicle, the travel control apparatus comprising a computer device configured to perform control to cause the vehicle to travel at a set constant vehicle speed or to cause the vehicle to travel following a preceding vehicle, wherein, the computer device comprises a determination unit configured to determine, before turn steering is started, whether it is a turn opportunity for the vehicle to make a first direction turn, the first direction turn being a turn made by the vehicle deviating from a current travel course without crossing an oncoming travel course, and
a target acceleration rate setting unit configured to, in a case where the determination unit determines that it is the turn opportunity, perform control to reduce acceleration before the turn steering is started.
[Claim 2] The travel control apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the determination unit determines that it is the turn opportunity in a case where a turn signal for the first direction turn is detected to be ON and an vehicle speed of the vehicle is less than a predetermined threshold.
[Claim 3] The travel control apparatus according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the target acceleration rate setting unit calculates a target acceleration rate by a first calculation method on a basis of at least a vehicle speed of the vehicle in a case where it is determined that it is the turn opportunity, and
calculates the target acceleration rate by a second calculation method on a basis of a steering angle and the vehicle speed in a case where it is not determined that it is the turn opportunity.
[Claim 4] The travel control apparatus according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the vehicle comprises a map locator, the determination unit assesses accuracy of the map locator, and,
upon assessing the accuracy to be unfavorable, the determination unit determines that it is the turn opportunity in a case where a turn signal for the first direction turn is detected to be ON and a vehicle speed of the vehicle is less than a predetermined threshold. 28 29
